subject: Social Media
title: Fyre Festival
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Fyre Festival.

hook.text: Supermodels posted orange tiles. Millions clicked. The luxury festival turned out to be tents and cheese sandwiches.

buildup.text: Fyre Festival used influencer marketing to sell a fantasy. Four hundred influencers posted simultaneously.

discovery.text: The campaign cost $250K per influencer post. None disclosed it was paid. The FTC investigated.

twist.text: Fyre proved influencer marketing could sell something that didn't exist. Trust was the product, not the event.

climax.text: Billy McFarland went to prison. The influencers faced zero consequences. Accountability was one-sided.

punchline.text: They sold a dream. They delivered a disaster.

quiz.question: What was the main marketing strategy behind Fyre Festival?
options: Coordinated influencer posts selling a luxury fantasy
